# Project instructions
## Project
Read docs/product-brief.md and docs/requirements.md.
Follow the approved design and implementation plan.
## Data and safety
Do not modify the original data in 00/.
Do not expose secrets or run destructive commands.
Ask before running commands that change files.
## Workflow
Work on one GitHub Issue at a time.
Read its acceptance criteria before suggesting changes.
Propose a short plan before implementing a feature.
Report what you actually checked or tested.
Do not claim success without verification.

Use the approved classic-games dataset as the source for game information, and never modify the original data in 00/.
Display No image available when a game image is missing, and Not Available for missing optional fields.
Keep category results to 12 games per page and search results to 20 games per page, with results alphabetized by title.
Ensure every page works on desktop and mobile, with accessible names, visible keyboard focus, and touch-friendly controls.
